incident-bot: PAGER: metering-service eu-west-1 detected token_count_drift -> threshold 2.5% now 8.9%. Alert ID MTR-20240320-42. Paging oncall.
Alex (oncall): ack — looking into it now.
Maya (sre): joining, pulling consumer logs from kafka-consumer-3 and shadow-emitter.
Ian (billing): quick recon — shadow emitter has duplicate key writes starting ~03:10 UTC, roughly 3h. Some customers are getting transient overage flags. sample ids: cust_84, cust_129 (non-prod masked).
Maya (sre): can we pause the shadow emitter upstream? that should stop duplicates while we triage.
Alex (oncall): @Ian can you confirm no downstream aggregation will break if we pause?
Ian (billing): pausing should be safe — production emitter is intact, shadow is only for replay. finance ok with temporary pause.
Maya (sre): doing pause now: `kubectl -n metering annotate deploy/shadow-emitter pause=true` -> `deployment.apps/shadow-emitter annotated` :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Shadow-emitter pause initiated by Maya at 1745501290. Backfill job queued: backfill-job-174550.
Ian (billing): double-check: `SELECT count(*) FROM shadow_emits WHERE dup_key IS TRUE AND ts > now() - interval '6 hours';` -> 4,812 duplicates. That's the likely source of overflagging.
Tom (eng): I'm prepping a small dedupe fix to the emitter deduper (drop if exact key already seen within 10m). Will push canary to eu-west-1 in ~10m.
Lina (product): product asks: customer comm? Support should delay automated overage emails until we confirm backfill. I'll draft a short note and ping #support.
Alex (oncall): handoff heads-up: my shift ends in 45m. @Maya please prepare a 1-pager runbook and set PD note on incident with current mitigation and next steps.
Maya (sre): runbook snippet (posting here): 1) confirm `emit_delta` metric normalizing; 2) ensure shadow-emitter annotated pause persists; 3) run backfill: `python tools/backfill_tokens.py --start 2024-03-20T00:00Z --end now --scope shadow` 4) validate billing counts vs shadow ledger, watch for customer flags.
Ian (billing): mitigation plan: 1) pause shadow (done), 2) run backfill -> reconcile -> if any overage emails already queued, cancel and issue credits. Finance & support looped.
Lina (product): draft sent to #support: "Holding overage emails for impacted window while we finish reconciliation. If customers received alerts, we'll proactively credit where appropriate."
Alex (oncall): update concise: pause complete, dup rate dropping. starting backfill now (job queued). will check in 25m.
Maya (sre): backfill started: job backfill-job-174550 running, ETA ~25m. current duplicate rate down to 2.1% (was 8.9%).
ops-bot: Monitoring probe: emit_dup_rate eu-west-1 = 2.1% -> trending down.
Ian (billing): note to handoff: if post-backfill drift remains >1% for 1h, escalate to billing-PM and eng lead for forced reprocess.
Tom (eng): canary patch pushed to eu-west-1 canary pods 2/3, no regressions so far. ready to promote if backfill clears.
Alex (oncall): leaving note in PD: MTR-20240320-42, mitigations applied (shadow pause, backfill started, canary running). Handoff to night team in 45m.
Maya (sre): leaving runbook + log pointers in #incidents pinned. I'll also attach `kafka-consumer-3` offsets and a short playbook for reprocessing offsets if needed.
Lina (product): support confirmed hold on outbound emails. finance ready to apply credits if customers see overage flags.
Alex (oncall): closing OOB: keep updates short. If we see any customer-impacting overage emails go out, mark as Sev2 and escalate.
incident-bot: Incident MTR-20240320-42 status: mitigated (partial) — monitoring for reoccurrence.
